title: Pragmatic Deeply Debiased ML
abstract: arXiv:2611.33069v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Debiased machine learning (DML) combines a fitted outcome regression with weighted residuals to remove first-order regularization bias when estimating parameters such as average treatment effects, yet a second-order bias remains whenever regression and weighting errors align. For linear regression functionals, we target this second-order bias by training a strong learner to predict first-stage residuals from many covariates, yielding a one-dimensional (or low-dimensional) working model whose bias contribution is estimated on an independent sample. To complement this targeted search, we also analyze general kernel-based corrections, including covariate partitions and smoothers. We prove that deeply debiased ML is algebraically identical to ordinary DML evaluated with a post-hoc regression update that adjusts each scored observation using kernel-weighted residuals from the remaining evaluation observations. translated_title: 实用的深度去偏机器学习
translated_abstract: 去偏机器学习（DML）通过将拟合的结果回归与加权残差相结合，在估计平均处理效应等参数时消除一阶正则化偏差，但当回归误差与加权误差方向一致时，仍会残留二阶偏差。针对线性回归泛函，我们通过训练一个强学习器从众多协变量中预测第一阶段残差，从而有针对性地消除这一二阶偏差，得到一个一维（或低维）的工作模型，其偏差贡献在独立样本上进行估计。作为对这种针对性搜索的补充，我们还分析了一般性的基于核函数的修正方法，包括协变量划分和平滑器。我们证明，深度去偏机器学习在代数上等价于使用事后回归更新进行评估的普通DML，即利用其余评估观测的核加权残差来调整每个被评分的观测。在我们的实证与模拟……
tldr: 该论文提出深度去偏机器学习方法，通过训练强学习器在低维工作模型中预测第一阶段残差来消除DML中的二阶偏差，并证明其代数上等价于使用核加权残差进行事后回归更新的普通DML。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes deeply debiased ML, which removes second-order bias in DML by training a strong learner to predict first-stage residuals within a low-dimensional working model, and proves it is algebraically identical to ordinary DML with a post-hoc kernel-weighted regression update.
